result:
US-009 is built and committed, but it doesn't meet DoD-S-01 yet. One frozen API test, AC-009-08, still fails because the Trash endpoint (US-012) doesn't exist.

- **Backend:** `POST /groups/{g}/contacts/search` now works.
  - Sorting uses the Slovenian collation, and ties break stably by id.
  - Search ignores case and accents and requires every word to match.
  - Search covers the own fields, tag names and attribute values, but not phone or notes.
  - `%`, `_` and SQL text are matched as plain text.
- **Web:** the Contacts tab is now the list. It has a search box, sortable columns (not tags), numbered paging, the total, and the empty and no-match states. A Viewer gets the same list, and the Add contact button shows only for Owner and Editor. Rows link to the contact screen.
- **Backend tests:** 18 of 19 frozen API tests pass. AC-009-08 is covered meanwhile by my own `ContactSearchIT`, which trashes the contact by SQL. Spotless, PMD and CPD are clean.
- **Frontend tests:** Vitest 152 pass, and tsc, eslint and prettier are clean. I had to adjust three of my own earlier tests that assumed the old placeholder. Browser tests AC-009-01, 06, 07, 10 and 11 pass in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
- **Other stories' tests:** Us005 shows three failures, AC-005-09, EX-005-12 and EX-005-09. All three need Trash (US-012) or History (US-013), not search.
- **Not done:** I didn't re-run the browser tests of US-006, US-007 and US-008 that were waiting on the list, and EX-009-08 (the 10,000-contact timing) belongs to the NFR tasks.
- **Decisions:** D-38 records my readings, including that the screen was written before its tests. Descending sort puts empty last names first. Ascending puts them last. `conditions` is ignored until US-010.

I split the work into five commits and kept the screen's own tests apart from its code, because together they were over the 400-line limit. The handover points to `/implement US-010` next. Logs are `02_output/logs/us009-backend.log`, `us009-backend2.log` and `us009-static.log`.
